marta: FYI the new sample-app prefill is doing a weird startup jitter — we're getting a burst of 429s and duplicate page fetches right after auth refresh. repro steps below.

sam: repro'd locally. looks like when the SDK refreshes creds mid-prefetch it restarts the prefetch loop and multiple parallel cursors converge on the same page. logs: `prefetch queue size=9 -> 429 -> retry-window`

lee: hunch: cursor affinity + a small singleflight on page key should stop duplicate fetches. also throttle new prefetches while token.refreshInProgress is true.

marta: minimal repro: `SAMPLE_PREFETCH=4 yarn start` then click Signup quickly. you can see network tab spamming `/pages?cursor=abc`.

sam: paste of a trimmed log: ```
[2025-02-12T08:03:21.123Z] prefetch: enqueuing cursor=abc, depth=3
[2025-02-12T08:03:21.456Z] auth: refreshing token
[2025-02-12T08:03:21.789Z] http 429 GET /pages?cursor=abc (concurrent=4)
[2025-02-12T08:03:22.001Z] retrying cursor=abc
```

maria: workaround for now: add jitter and an AbortController per cursor so stale prefetches get cancelled if we detect a newer fetch for same cursor. also reduce prefetch window to 1 or 2 during signup flow.

lee: proposed SDK patch (sketch): ```js
// options
{ maxPrefetchConcurrency: 2, cursorAffinity: true, prefetchBackoffMs: (i)=> 50 * Math.pow(2,i) }

// singleflight
if (inFlightFetches.has(cursor)) return inFlightFetches.get(cursor)
```

alex: can we add an opt-in `prefetchMode: "conservative"` that sets those defaults for sample apps? would be helpful for onboarding where auth churn is common. also add an e2e that simulates token expiry during prefill.

sam: i'll prototype `cursorAffinity` and the AbortController cancellation. if it looks clean i'll open a PR and add unit tests around concurrency limits.

deploy-bot: deploy v2.4.1-preview to staging started by @sam :rocket:

marta: thanks — please tag dx:prefill and owners=@devex in the PR. if prototype works we should ship this as a non-breaking opt-in in the next minor so sample-apps stop recommending high prefetch during signup. :thumbsup:

alex: note for the doc side: add a short section in onboarding caveats about token refresh and prefetch (suggest lowering SAMPLE_PREFETCH or using conservative prefetchMode).

sam: assigned, will post a short design doc in #devex when I have the details.

marta: assigning to @sam to own the prototype. follow-up meeting tomorrow 10am to decide defaults.
